svg.text: How one hand cooks with passive ware: grip, press, turn, pare, flip and wash, with no new seal.
2 novel mechanisms: N1 EPM tang chuck, N2 generic produce module
7 motion actuators in the cell: X, Y, Z, roll, chuck, T, S
4 dynamic seals (3 sealing bands + roll lip seal); T and S canned
one washer for ware and dishes, 70 °C hold for 10 min

g.text: N1 Tang chuck: pins + electro-permanent magnet
Pins locate and take shear; the EPM holds, no moving part.
Pull-off ≈ 400 N × 30 mm = 12 Nm against 6.4 Nm (×1.9).
Every grip is checked by load cell and flux sensor.
Tongs: fixed ring EPM holds a 2nd ring, the roll closes them.
Screw-press cassette turned by the roll axis
Torque in the ware: no press drive, no seal.
Rd 28 × 6 screw: 30 Nm → ≈ 2.5 kN on the piston.
Bought push-dicer grids 6/10/15; also slice, wedge, ricer,
Spätzle and a Ø 70 orifice for patties. Washed as ware.
Canned magnet drive through the deck (T and S)
Torque passes through a closed steel cup: no hole, no seal.
Motor and inner rotor stay dry under the deck.
T: thimble Ø 90 × 50, 25 Nm, 0–500 rpm (bowl, drum).
S: thimble Ø 40 × 20, 1.5 Nm, 0–6000 rpm (jug, cups).
Firm items: spit + blade post, depth shoes 1 / 2.5 / 5–6 mm.
Soft halves skin up on a grid: the piston presses the flesh
through, the skin stays behind and goes to waste.
Plus blanch-and-slip, cook in the skin, corers and pitter.
rack pair turned in air, not the pan
golden side up, back into the fat
Lower rack in the fat, upper rack set on, pair lifted,
rolled 180° about the tang axis and lowered again.
Rule: never invert a pan holding more than 30 mL fat.
Same idea: pan pair for pancakes, raft for Rouladen.
One washer, side loading, for ware and dishes
Items rolled on edge and pushed in +X onto tang rails or
the comb rack; wash system of a bought slim dishwasher.
14 plates + 6 glasses + cutlery, or 8–10 ware items, ≈ 30 min.
One-way flow: clean items out to the cabinet before loading.
